identity.name: Sulphite ammonia caramel (Caramel colour, Class IV)

function.mechanism: Produced by controlled heat treatment of carbohydrates with ammonium- and sulfite-containing compounds to form brown colour bodies used to darken foods and beverages.

adi.basis: Group ADI for combined exposure to caramel colours E150a,b,c,d (2011 re-evaluation; refined 2012 exposure review kept combined exposure below group ADI).

efsa.key_finding: EFSA re-evaluation established a group ADI and later refined exposure estimates; combined exposure to E150a,b,c,d did not exceed the group ADI in the 2012 refinement.

adi.basis: JECFA Class IV caramel colour ADI 0-200 mg/kg bw (comment notes 0-150 mg/kg bw on a solids basis).

concerns.summary: A related process constituent, 4-methylimidazole (4-MEI), is classified by IARC as Group 2B and has mouse lung tumour findings at high experimental doses.
High-dose multigenerational rat data for 4-MEI reported reproductive/developmental effects with a LOAEL around 50-60 mg/kg bw/day in that study context.

no_concern_confirmed: Historical long-term rodent studies of Caramel Colour IV reported no carcinogenicity at up to 10 g/kg bw/day in drinking-water studies (PMID: 1644385).
Weight-of-evidence assessment reported no clear in vivo genotoxicity for 4-MEI (PMID: 32745573).

populations: toddlers/high consumers in earlier EFSA screening scenarios
high consumers for E150c in EFSA 2012 refined assessment
adi_exceedance.notes: EFSA 2012 refinement reported combined exposure to E150a,b,c,d below the group ADI, but subgroup/high-consumer caveats remained in class-specific assessments.

risk_assessment.rationale: E150d is permitted by major regulators with ADI/GMP controls, but safety management depends on controlling process-related constituents (notably 4-MEI) and monitoring high-end subgroup exposure scenarios.
key_factors: EFSA group ADI with refined exposure generally below the combined threshold
FDA CFR allows use under GMP and lists caramel as GRAS
JECFA numerical ADI for Class IV caramel
IARC Group 2B classification for related constituent 4-MEI
